cards.title: The pharmacotherapeutic use of clozapine in older adults: A narrative review.
cards.what: Clozapine remains the gold-standard treatment for refractory schizophrenia, yet its use in older adults is often limited by concerns regarding tolerability, age-related pharmacokinetic changes, and the burden of medical comorbidities. This narrative review synthesises current evidence on clozapine use in older populations, with a focus on pharmacokinetic alterations, dosing strategies, comorbidity-related considerations, and clozapine's therapeutic benefits, safety, and risks.
cards.why: Aging affects clozapine plasma concentrations, increasing susceptibility to adverse effects.
cards.pkpd_hook: Aging leads to increased clozapine and norclozapine plasma concentrations.
cards.original_title: The pharmacotherapeutic use of clozapine in older adults: A narrative review.
cards.headline: The pharmacotherapeutic use of clozapine in older adults

cards.title: Optimising posaconazole dosing in paediatric patients: a population pharmacokinetic modelling and simulation study.
cards.what: Posaconazole is approved for prophylaxis and treatment of invasive fungal infections in paediatric patients, but data for optimal formulation-specific dosing across the paediatric weight range remains scant. We pooled individual-level pharmacokinetic data to identify dosing regimens that optimise the probability of achieving predefined efficacy and safety targets.
cards.why: Study identifies suboptimal oral suspension and suggests loading dose for intravenous and delayed-release tablet formulations
cards.pkpd_hook: Bioavailability varies with dose, proton pump inhibitor use, and diarrhoea; trough concentration targets not consistently met with current dosing regimens
cards.source: PubMed, Clinical microbiology and infection : the official publication of the European Society of Clinical Microbiology and Infectious Diseases
cards.original_title: Optimising posaconazole dosing in paediatric patients: a population pharmacokinetic modelling and simulation study.
cards.headline: Optimising posaconazole dosing in paediatric patients

cards.title: Povorcitinib authorised in the EU for active moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (acne inversa) in adults who have responded inadequately to, or who are intolerant or contraindicated to an anti-TNF therapy
cards.what: povorcitinib is indicated for the treatment of active moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa (acne inversa) in adults who have responded inadequately to, or who are intolerant or contraindicated to an anti-TNF therapy.
cards.why: A new drug, povorcitinib, is now authorized for treating moderate to severe hidradenitis suppurativa in adults who have not responded or are intolerant to anti-TNF therapy.
cards.pkpd_hook: The drug's pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic properties in relation to this indication remain undisclosed.

reason.text: In today's interaction: maraviroc and nelfinavir

used_for.text: Maraviroc is an HIV medicine used to treat patients from 2 years of age and weighing at least 10 kg who are infected with human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1), a virus that causes acquired immune deficiency syndrome (AIDS).
used_for.source: EMA summary of one medicine with this substance

sentences: nelfinavir is a strong inhibitor of CYP3A and maraviroc is a sensitive substrate of CYP3A, so maraviroc exposure can be higher.
